title: ProdOps KPI Runway — Field Guide
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, transportable field guide for Product Ops to drive roadmap tracking, KPI synchronization, and launch readiness for medium-sized feature launches (pilot -> GA). It is intentionally lightweight so PMs and Eng leads can use it as a single source of launch status during the final 6 weeks before go-live.

When to use this doc:
- Feature pilots, paid beta rollouts, and incremental capacity launches where cross-functional coordination matters and we want a focused KPI runway rather than a heavyweight launch binder.
- Use it at T-6 weeks to onboard stakeholders, maintain a single KPI cadence, and run weekly readiness syncs.

Summary of the guide:
1) Roadmap lanes and owners (single line view)
2) Compact KPI tracker (weekly cadence)
3) Launch readiness checklist (go/no-go criteria + owners)
4) Risk and fallback binder (short descriptions + triggers)
5) Post-launch stabilization window and early metrics plan

1) Roadmap lanes (T-6 -> T+2)
- Product (PM): Elena Park — features frozen at T-2 weeks for GA.
- Engineering (ENG): Marcus Silva — staging perf target met by T-1w.
- Serving & Infra (SERVE): Diego Martinez — capacity reserved and smoke tests green.
- SRE/Observability (SRE): Priya Patel — dashboards and alerts in prod namespace.
- Customer Success (CS): Ava Chen — beta cohort ready and playbooks finalized.
- Legal/Compliance (LEGAL): Jonah Klein — data processing addendum signed for enterprise beta.

2) Compact KPI tracker (weekly snapshot)
(Use this as the canonical PD: one line per metric; update weekly; color code in the tracking sheet UI)

Metric | Target (GA) | Baseline (T-6) | Current (T-1) | Owner | Signal / Action
Activation conversion (trial->paid) | 8% | 3.2% | 6.1% | PM (Elena) | If <6% at T-1 -> adjust onboarding flows, enable in-product tips
Mean API latency (p50) | <120ms | 220ms | 130ms | ENG (Marcus) | If >150ms -> enable reduced batch sizes, route to dedicated pool
Token cost per session | <$0.015 | $0.022 | $0.017 | ENG/Serve (Marcus/Diego) | If >$0.018 -> enable quantized variant fallback for non-critical routes
Error rate (5xx) | <0.1% | 0.6% | 0.15% | SRE (Priya) | If >0.3% -> enable canary rollback and throttle new traffic
Customer NPS (pilot cohort) | >=55 | 48 | 52 | CS (Ava) | If <50 -> schedule 1:1 outreach and prioritize fixes
Adoption (% active weekly users) | 10% | 2.1% | 6.4% | PM (Elena) | If <8% -> widen beta cohort and surface onboarding issues

Notes on tracker usage:
- Update every Monday before the readiness sync.
- Use the "Signal / Action" column to capture the immediate mitigation so ops can act in-triage.
- This is deliberately compact — heavyweight measurement lives in the analytics repository, this is the executive runway view.

3) Launch readiness checklist (canonical pre-flight items)
Status codes: TODO / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED / DONE
- Product: Feature spec final, acceptance tests written — Owner: Elena Park — Status: IN_PROGRESS
- Engineering: Smoke tests pass on staging with 95th percentile latency under target — Owner: Marcus Silva — Status: IN_PROGRESS
- Serving: Capacity config and autoscale policy deployed to prod namespace; fallback model registered — Owner: Diego Martinez — Status: IN_PROGRESS
- SRE: Dashboards, SLO alerting, and on-call runbook published — Owner: Priya Patel — Status: TODO
- Security: Data flow diagram and threat review completed — Owner: Jonah Klein — Status: DONE
- Support: CS playbook + triage doc and escalation path created — Owner: Ava Chen — Status: TODO
- Legal: DPA & terms updated for pilot customers — Owner: Jonah Klein — Status: DONE
- Monitoring: Synthetic traffic with golden dataset running for 72h — Owner: Priya Patel — Status: IN_PROGRESS
- Release: Canary plan and rollback steps documented in GitHub release notes — Owner: Marcus Silva — Status: IN_PROGRESS

Go/No-Go criteria (minimum pass to proceed to GA):
- Core acceptance tests: all critical acceptance tests passing in staging for 48h with no new regressions.
- Performance: p50 latency under target and error rate <0.3% on canary traffic.
- Cost: token cost per session within 10% of expected unit economics for GA.
- Support readiness: CS has scripted first 50 outreach messages and two on-call shifts covered.
- Compliance: any required enterprise paperwork (DPA, SOC audit notes) addressed for paying customers.

Sign-off flow (simple): PM -> ENG -> SRE -> Legal -> CS -> Exec sponsor. Each sign-off must be an explicit message in the launch Slack channel and a linked GitHub release.

4) Risk & fallback binder (short descriptions + triggers)
- Risk: Model quality regression in long-tail prompts. Trigger: automated quality eval drop >5% on core prompt set at T-1. Fallback: route to baseline model and disable experimental scoring; postmortem and targeted retrain. Owner: Research.
- Risk: Capacity crunch during first 48h. Trigger: sustained QPS > 2x forecast for 30 minutes. Fallback: enable surge policy to burst to reserved pool and apply rate-limiter with graceful degradation for non-critical endpoints. Owner: Serve/Infra.
- Risk: Billing/backfill discrepancy. Trigger: sudden spike in token cost per session >2x estimated. Fallback: pause GA rollout, contact finance, disable highest-cost features. Owner: Finance + PM.

5) Post-launch stabilization (T+0 -> T+14)
- Stabilization window: first 72h is hyper-watch: daily demo, metric review at 09:00 PT and 21:00 PT.
- T+7 health check: business KPIs (activation, adoption, costs) vs baseline — decision to expand cohort or hold.
- T+14 retrospective: collect notes from all lanes and produce a concise 1-pager with action items.

Weekly cadence (recommended):
- Mondays: KPI snapshot update (this doc), product/eng re-prioritization call.
- Wednesdays: SRE/infra sync (perf, monitoring).
- Fridays: CS feedback and action backlog review.

Quick operational play snippets (copy/paste into runbook):
- If error rate >0.3%: immediately reduce non-critical background batch jobs, switch to canary routing (50% traffic to canary), inform on-call.
- If latency p50 spikes >200ms: reduce batch size to 1 for affected endpoint and enable dedicated pool routing.
- If token cost > threshold: enable quantized smaller model for non-authenticated/low-value flows and notify finance.

Appendix: Short checklist for the launch sync meeting (15 minutes):
1) Quick metric run-through (2 minutes)
2) Top 2 blockers and owners (6 minutes)
3) Immediate mitigations and who is doing what (4 minutes)
4) Confirm runway confidence score (go/no-go candidate) (3 minutes)

Change log (mini):
- 2025-11-12: Initial seed (T-6 checklist template).
- 2026-01-09: Added KPI columns and cost mitigation snippets after pilot review.
- 2026-02-28: Updated go/no-go thresholds and sign-off flow per exec feedback.

Document usage note:
This doc is not the exhaustive launch binder — it is the working runway. Keep it focused, update weekly, and attach more detailed artifacts (postmortems, compliance packets, deeper metrics) as links in the linked_artifacts field.

End of guide.
